# You Obsess. We handle the rest.

As the complete Merchant of Record, Paddle helps digital product companies to operate and grow, automatically.

### Digital businesses can reach customers globally almost instantly today. But global growth gets heavy fast. Complexity compounds. Momentum slows.

### That’s the weight Paddle takes. As the complete Merchant of Record, Paddle handles the operational and regulatory complexity of scaling selling globally, so you can scale fast with confidence.
